item.title: Arundhati Roy ‘shocked’ by jury’s Gaza remarks, quits Berlin film festival

item.description: Wael Mesheh, from the West Bank, had wanted to study. But his life took a turn after being imprisoned by Israel.

item.title: Danish PM says more Greenland talks due after meeting US’s Marco Rubio
item.description: New opinion poll finds seven in 10 US adults disapprove of President Donald Trump's handling of Greenland issue.

item.description: The cricket world and beyond will be watching as one of sport's greatest rivalry goes ahead despite political turmoil.
